decisions.reason: The module has its own page and a public launch announcement, showing visible commitment and sunk investment that make withdrawal hard to justify.
As the third generation replacing a predecessor, it represents substantial past investment and a public commitment to the measurement line, so escalation pressures favor keeping it.
Though only mentioned on the website rather than given its own page, it is an established connectivity module and past investment and public mention create enough commitment to persist.
With its own page and public launch, the CO2 sensor is a visible part of the announced module expansion, so sunk costs and public commitment make management likely to keep it.
